{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print("First 5 rows of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique revenue values with commas:")
print(sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())

# Check for non-numeric entries
print("\nNon-numeric revenue entries (if any):")
non_numeric = sales['revenue'].apply(lambda x: not isinstance(x, str) or not x.replace(',', '').replace('.', '').isdigit())
print(sales[non_numeric]['revenue'].unique())"}
